_comment: NBA award marks entered by hand: a feat no Basketball-Reference column holds (generateAwards.js reads this; the WNBA's own file is wnba-manual-awards.json). Season (the end year), then the mark's code, then the player's Basketball-Reference id and name. Every card of that player-season prints the mark. A code here must be declared in src/cards/awards.js with `manual: true`. After an edit: node scripts/cardgen/generateAwards.js, then re-export the card's face.
